A bit of a personal challenge I set myself with my current book is to write the first draft entirely by hand. It's gotten off to a bad start because I had already written the first 8k words in a document a few years ago, but I think I'll manage to get it done. There are a few downsides, the main two being my handwriting being not the best in the world and the fact I can fit a lot more on one page of a document than I can a sheet of A4 paper. It looks like this could take two, or maybe even three, notepads.

Have you ever written a book out by hand? What was it like?

When I write I always use a note book for a very, very rough draft that's more of an outline without dialogue. I find it is easier to do because I can write I the margins, flip back and forth for continuity much easier, and overall it's just much more fluid. If my final novel is 100,000 words then my notebook is about 30,000 words. In the end, it's just what works for you though. And Joining a writing group helps!
